data.gender_notes: Jaella is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jaella is derived from the Arabic word 'Ja'll', meaning gentle, and 'Al-Jasm', meaning jasmine. This beautiful name carries the essence of tranquility and grace, evoking images of the delicate and fragrant jasmine flower. The name Jaella carries the meaning “Gentle Jasmine” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaella usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle jasmine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of peace and purity in Islam.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaella total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
